name: com.gamecore.replay
description: GC-023's canonical replay fixture: recorded input traces, state/event hashing with a documented exclusion list, the 10,000-step integer fixture, the worker-scheduling model, engine-observation replay separated from native-physics comparison, differential propagation with a deterministic reducer, the fixed compact telemetry collector and the raw benchmark trace format. Unity-free by design so the same fixtures run in plain dotnet, in Unity EditMode and in the qualification player.
